main_text.p: temus, vt quæ duæ hæreticorum notæ ab Irenæo quondam assignatæ sunt,in scriptu-ræ simplicis authoritate non acquiescere,traditiones alias iactitare, eæ nobis ambæ merito inu-rantur.

page.notes: The text is set in a mixture of roman and heavy type; the line "acquiescere" appears with a reversed or dropped letter in the scan and is transcribed as printed. The woodcut ornament between the text and the foot is omitted. The faint, mirrored text of the reverse page is show-through and is not transcribed. The marginal note "Iren.l.3." is printed beside the first line; the original may read "Iren. l. 3." with a lowered numeral. The foot line "SECT." follows the signature "K 3" and is recorded as a catchword-type element in the bottom margin, not transcribed as text.
